titlePlain: Migrating the Static Assets to Blob
subtitle: Lesson 4 · Chapter 1: Migrating the First Workload to Azure

code:
az storage container create \
  --account-name stdriftwoodimages \
  --name product-images \
  --auth-mode login
caption: A flat namespace -- folder-like blob names display as folders in the portal.

steps.label: Right tier
steps.sub: Hot -- lowest access cost, no delay

code:
az storage blob upload-batch \
  --account-name stdriftwoodimages \
  --destination product-images \
  --source ./on-prem-export/product-images \
  --tier Hot
caption: One command, every file in the exported folder, at the Hot tier.
